title: An Armored Amphibian That Lived Its Whole Life at Sea? It's a Fossil First
caption:
Meet the Gerrothorax maritimus, a 237-million-year-old fossil that challenges everything we know about amphibians. Unlike modern species, this creature was covered in armor and lived entirely at sea.

Source: Sciencealert - An Armored Amphibian That Lived Its Whole Life at Sea? It's a Fossil First
